description: Synthetic performance planning profile for the service-operations MVP. This is not a benchmark result.
privacy_rules: Do not use customer exports, production logs, production database snapshots, real contact details, or prompt bodies.
Keep benchmark results with infrastructure identifiers or operational logs outside the public repository.
Use deterministic fake customers, items, service locations, work orders, time rows, part rows, and AI proposals.

required_evidence: p95 list latency recorded
role-scoped filters still hide unauthorized records
slow filters have an owner or mitigation
p95 search latency recorded
search uses synthetic data only
permissions still apply

scenarios.surface: Finance invoice-ready and draft invoice action
required_evidence: draft invoice action p95 latency recorded
retry creates exactly one linked draft Sales Invoice
draft invoice does not submit or update stock

scenarios.surface: Manager parts issue and stock handoff
required_evidence: parts issue action p95 latency recorded
concurrent retry remains idempotent and creates exactly one submitted Stock Entry
linked part rows remain immutable after issue

scenarios.surface: AI closeout payload build, validation, proposal storage, and review
required_evidence: AI draft path p95 latency recorded without provider latency
payload contains allow-listed fields only
approval records review only and has no ERP side effect
queue backlog clears within target
failed jobs are observable
scheduler remains healthy

scenarios.surface: Service profitability, exception, and invoice-readiness reports
required_evidence: report p95 latency recorded
report is scoped to authorized records
report does not require unsafe denormalization
